title: The Day the Internet Almost Died

scenes.text: What if the *entire internet* vanished — for everyone, at once?
In *1997,* one misconfigured router in Virginia nearly made that real.
It flooded the world's networks with bad data, and huge parts of the *internet went dark.*
Today it's even more fragile: about *99% of international data* runs through *undersea cables* you'll never see.
A handful of cuts in the right place could cut off *entire countries* overnight.
We built a civilization that runs on wires sitting at the *bottom of the ocean.*
Follow for more *lost secrets* of history.
